passes.note: Concept pass: lifecycle artifact classifier is narrow (storyId + path prefix + closed filename set) and adversarially proven to keep rejecting product source and arbitrary .koala/foo.json; strict-prefix branch returns null on unknown filenames so .koala/story/actives/<id>/secrets.json still fails. Convergence hardening anchors .build (and other derived dirs) by exact directory name and uses lstatSync + symlink skip in walkDir/scanTruth; symlink-loop fixture confirms no ELOOP and docs/requirements/docs/story remain visible. session_brief TEST-branch consumes scopeBlocking before recommending DONE with the required wording. TEST-phase scope_contract_acknowledge is forbidden via command-policy allowedPhases=[DEV,REVIEW]. No weakening of product-source scope enforcement observed.

Quality pass: classifyLifecycleArtifact is filename-aware + story-scoped with strict STORY_ID_RE; runtime-artifact registry consumed via isRuntimeArtifactPath (no blanket .koala/ exemption — explicitly asserted in verify-process-fact-contract.mjs). walkDir / collectMdFiles use lstatSync + isSymbolicLink skip and wrap readdirSync in try/catch with defensive nested catch on recursion — symlink-loop fixture proves no ELOOP and docs/requirements + real source remain visible. computeNextStep TEST branch consumes scopeBlocking derived from the same ScopeProtectionSummary that renders the brief row, so they cannot disagree; corrupt scope-contract.json also surfaces a fail-closed blocker. Source-receipt smoke checks in verify-gap-convergence.mjs and verify-session-brief-command-center.mjs are defensive contracts backed by real behavioural fixtures (and the session-brief receipt is explicitly justified because runtime synthesis of phase=TEST with a blocking scope is non-trivial) — not brittle enough to block. Pre-existing role-aware next-step assertion in verify-session-brief-command-center.mjs is brittle in REVIEW phase but it predates B-b9d0 and was not modified by this story; quality scope here is unchanged. No weakening of product-source scope enforcement observed.
